58611-new-hampshire-a-poem-with-notes-an.title: Copyright, 1923
58611-new-hampshire-a-poem-with-notes-an.creator: Henry Holt And Company
58611-new-hampshire-a-poem-with-notes-an.description: A book by Henry Holt And Company. I met a lady from the South who said (You won't believe she said it, but she said it): "None of my family ever worked, or had A thing to sell." I don't suppose the work Much matters. You may work for all of me.

arxiv-1511-04316.title: Particle creation rate for dynamical black holes
arxiv-1511-04316.creator: Javad T. Firouzjaee 1,2, George F R Ellis 3
arxiv-1511-04316.description: Abstract Abstract We present the particle creation probability rate around a general black hole as an outcome of quantum fluctuations. Using the uncertainty principle for these fluctuation, we derive a new ultraviolet frequency cutoff for the radiation spectrum of a dynamical black hole. Using this frequency cutoff, we define the probability creation rate function for such black holes.

arxiv-1812-03849.title: Weakly Supervised Dense Event Captioning in Videos
arxiv-1812-03849.creator: Xuguang Duan, Wenbing Huang, Chuang Gan, Jingdong Wang, Wenwu Zhu, Junzhou Huang
arxiv-1812-03849.description: Abstract Dense event captioning aims to detect and describe all events of interest contained in a video. Despite the advanced development in this area, existing methods tackle this task by making use of dense temporal annotations, which is dramatically source-consuming.

arxiv-1911-03586.title: On-the-fly ab initio semiclassical evaluation of electronic coherences in polyatomic molecules reveals a simple mechanism of decoherence
arxiv-1911-03586.creator: Nikolay V. Golubev, Tomislav Begušić, Jiří Vaníček
arxiv-1911-03586.description: Abstract Irradiation of a molecular system by an intense laser field can trigger dynamics of both electronic and nuclear subsystems. The lighter electrons usually move on much faster, attosecond time scale but the slow nuclear rearrangement damps ultrafast electronic oscillations, leading to the decoherence of the electronic dynamics within a few femtoseconds.

arxiv-2102-13472.title: A Quantitative Metric for Privacy Leakage in Federated Learning
arxiv-2102-13472.creator: Yong Liu \sthanks Work done as an intern at Ping An Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd, Xinghua Zhu \sthanks These authors contributed equally to this work, Jianzong Wang \sthanks Corresponding author: jzwang@188.com, Jing Xiao
arxiv-2102-13472.description: Abstract In the federated learning system, parameter gradients are shared among participants and the central modulator, while the original data never leave their protected source domain. However, the gradient itself might carry enough information for precise inference of the original data. By reporting their parameter gradients to the central server, client datasets are exposed to inference attacks from adversaries.

arxiv-2111-09431.title: Exploring smoking-gun signals of the Schwinger mechanism in QCD
arxiv-2111-09431.creator: A. C. Aguilar, M. N. Ferreira, J. Papavassiliou
arxiv-2111-09431.description: Abstract In QCD, the Schwinger mechanism endows the gluons with an effective mass through the dynamical formation of massless bound-state poles that are longitudinally coupled. The presence of these poles affects profoundly the infrared properties of the interaction vertices, inducing crucial modifications to their fundamental Ward identities.

arxiv-2201-07312.title: Model-driven Cluster Resource Management for AI Workloads in Edge Clouds
arxiv-2201-07312.creator: Qianlin Liang, Walid A. Hanafy, Ahmed Ali-Eldin, Prashant Shenoy
arxiv-2201-07312.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Qianlin Liang, Walid A. Hanafy, Ahmed Ali-Eldin, Prashant Shenoy. Since emerging edge applications such as Internet of Things (IoT) analytics and augmented reality have tight latency constraints, hardware AI accelerators have been recently proposed to speed up deep neural network (DNN) inference run by these applications. Resource-constrained edge servers and accelerators tend to be multiplexed across multiple IoT applications, introducing the potential for performance interference between latency-sensitive workloads.

arxiv-2211-04185.title: Coupled Modeling and Fusion Control for a Multi-modal Deformable Land-air Robot
arxiv-2211-04185.creator: Xinyu Zhang İD, Yuanhao Huang İD, Kangyao Huang İD, Ziqi Zhao, Jingwei Li, Huaping Liu İD, Jun Li
arxiv-2211-04185.description: Abstract A deformable land-air robot is introduced with excellent driving and flying capabilities, offering a smooth switching mechanism between the two modes. An elaborate coupled dynamics model is established for the robot, including rotors, chassis, suspension, and the deformable structure.

arxiv-2412-02911.title: Measuring and Forecasting Conversation Incivility: the Role of Antisocial and Prosocial Behaviors
arxiv-2412-02911.creator: Xinchen Yu, Hayden Arnold, Benjamin Su, Eduardo Blanco
arxiv-2412-02911.description: Abstract This paper focuses on the task of measuring and forecasting incivility in conversations following replies to hate speech. Identifying replies that steer conversations away from hatred and elicit civil follow-up conversations sheds light into effective strategies to engage with hate speech and proactively avoid further escalation.

arxiv-2502-03486.title: Simple ϕ ​ Λ \phi\Lambda CDM dynamics Accepted: 27 Feb 2025
arxiv-2502-03486.creator: Pierros Ntelis, Jackson Levi Said
arxiv-2502-03486.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce the ϕ ​ Λ \phi\Lambda CDM model and compare it to the concordance model. We present their respective epoch evolutions, perform a detailed dynamical analysis for each model, and conduct a comparative analysis between the two. This study revitalizes these models by considering systems with a higher number of variables.

arxiv-2502-08832.title: LSM Trees in Adversarial Environments
arxiv-2502-08832.creator: Hayder Tirmazi
arxiv-2502-08832.description: Abstract . The Log Structured Merge (LSM) Tree is a popular choice for key-value stores focusing on optimized write throughput while maintaining performant, production-ready read latencies. LSM stores rely on a probabilistic data structure called the Bloom Filter (BF) to optimize read performance.

arxiv-2503-18748.title: Simulation-Driven Balancing of Competitive Game Levels with Reinforcement Learning Thanks: This research was supported by the Volkswagen Foundation (Project: Consequences of Artificial Intelligence on Urban Societies, Grant 98555).
arxiv-2503-18748.creator: Florian Rupp, Manuel Eberhardinger, Kai Eckert
arxiv-2503-18748.description: Abstract The balancing process for game levels in competitive two-player contexts involves a lot of manual work and testing, particularly for non-symmetrical game levels. In this work, we frame game balancing as a procedural content generation task and propose an architecture for automatically balancing of tile-based levels within the PCGRL framework (procedural content generation via reinforcement learning).

arxiv-2509-04909.creator: architecture

arxiv-2512-00996.title: The Dual Wavelet Spectra: An Alternative Perspective on Hurst Exponent Estimation with Application to Mammogram Classification
arxiv-2512-00996.creator: Raymond J. Hinton, Jr, Pepa Ramírez Cobo, Brani Vidakovic
arxiv-2512-00996.description: Abstract The wavelet spectra is a common starting point for estimating the Hurst exponent of a self-similar signal using wavelet-based techniques. The decay of the log 2 \log_{2} average energy of the detail wavelet coefficients as a function of the level of signal decomposition can be used to construct estimators for this parameter.

arxiv-2512-23209.title: Extremal A ​ B ​ S ABS Spectral Radius in Bicyclic and Bipartite Unicyclic Graphs
arxiv-2512-23209.description: Abstract The A ​ B ​ S ABS spectral radius of a graph G G is defined as the largest eigenvalue of its A ​ B ​ S ABS matrix. Motivated by recent studies on this parameter, in this paper, we determine the bipartite unicyclic graphs that attain the largest A ​ B ​ S ABS spectral radius.

arxiv-2601-23242.title: Physical origin of very-high-energy gamma rays from the low-luminosity active galactic nucleus NGC 4278 and implications for neutrino observations
arxiv-2601-23242.creator: Shilong Chen, Abhishek Das, B. Theodore Zhang, Shigeo S. Kimura, Kohta Murase, Yunfeng Liang
arxiv-2601-23242.description: Abstract Relativistic jets in active galactic nuclei (AGNs) are known to accelerate particles to extreme energies, yet the physical origin of very-high-energy (VHE) emission from low-luminosity AGNs (LL AGNs) remains unclear. NGC 4278, a local LLAGN, has recently been identified as a VHE source following detections by LHAASO.

arxiv-2602-04372.title: Revealing the interfacial kinetic mechanisms in high-entropy doped Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 through electrochemical investigation and distribution of relaxation times
arxiv-2602-04372.creator: Manish Kr. Singh, Rajendra S. Dhaka
arxiv-2602-04372.description: Abstract We designed a high-entropy doped NASICON cathode, Na 3 V 1.9 (CrMoAlZrNi) 0.1 (PO 4 ) 3 and investigate its electrochemical performance for sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) to understand the diffusion mechanism including distribution of relaxation times analysis of interfacial kinetics.

arxiv-2604-02725.title: What Are Pulsar Companions Made of? Using Gravitational Tides to Probe Their Compositions
arxiv-2604-02725.creator: Liam Colombo-Murphy, Lucas Brown, Stefano Profumo, M. Grant Roberts, Aya Westerling

europmc-pmc7774470.title: The 'Digital Twin' to enable the vision of precision cardiology.
europmc-pmc7774470.creator: Corral-Acero J, Margara F, Marciniak M, Rodero C, Loncaric F, Feng Y, Gilbert A, Fernandes JF, Bukhari HA, Wajdan A, Martinez MV, Santos MS, Shamohammdi M, Luo H, Westphal P, Leeson P, DiAchille P, Gurev V, Mayr M, Geris L, Pathmanathan P, Morrison T, Cornelussen R, Prinzen F, Delhaas T, Doltra A, Sitges M, Vigmond EJ, Zacur E, Grau V, Rodriguez B, Remme EW, Niederer S, Mortier P, McLeod K, Potse M, Pueyo E, Bueno-Orovio A, Lamata P.
europmc-pmc7774470.description: Providing therapies tailored to each patient is the vision of precision medicine, enabled by the increasing ability to capture extensive data about individual patients. In this position paper, we argue that the second enabling pillar towards this vision is the increasing power...

pmc-10597296.title: Costs and control strategies of healthcare-associated infections in an Italian university hospital
pmc-10597296.creator: C Mosconi, C De Santo, F Ciccacci, M Carestia, L Guarente, D Di Giovanni, G Morlino, S Moramarco, M Cicala, S Orlando
pmc-10597296.description: BackgroundsHealthcare-associated infections (HAIs) increase morbidity, mortality, and costs, necessitating effective prevention strategies. This study estimates the additional costs of HAIs in a university hospital in Rome, Italy Policlinico Tor Vergata (PTV), to inform policymakers, healthcare professionals, and researchers.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective cohort study, including all patients admitted or discharged in 2018.

pmc-10703765.title: Decreased expression of TFF2 and decreased αGlcNAc glycosylation are malignant biomarkers of pyloric gland adenoma of the duodenum
pmc-10703765.creator: Kazuhiro Yamanoi, Chifumi Fujii, Atsushi Nakayama, Noriko Matsuura, Yusaku Takatori, Motohiko Kato, Naohisa Yahagi, Jun Nakayama
pmc-10703765.description: Pyloric gland adenoma (PGA) is a duodenal neoplasm expressing MUC6 and is often associated with high-grade dysplasia and adenocarcinoma. MUC6 secreted from the pyloric gland cells carries unique O-glycans exhibiting terminal α1,4-linked N-acetylglucosamine residues (αGlcNAc). The small peptide trefoil factor 2 (TFF2) is also secreted from pyloric gland cells and binds to αGlcNAc.

pmc-11308501.title: Pozelimab for CHAPLE disease: results from in-trial interviews and clinical outcome assessments
pmc-11308501.creator: Leighann Litcher-Kelly, Ahmet Ozen, Sarah Ollis, Hagit Baris Feldman, Andrew Yaworsky, Paolo Medrano, Voranush Chongsrisawa, Taylor Brackin, Lorah Perlee, Marisa Walker, Sharanya Pradeep, Michael J. Lenardo, Olivier A. Harari, Jessica J. Jalbert
pmc-11308501.description: BackgroundCD55 deficiency with hyper-activation of complement, angiopathic thrombosis, and protein-losing enteropathy (CHAPLE) disease is ultra-rare (< 100 children or young adults worldwide) and potentially fatal. The study used mixed-methods approaches to assess how pozelimab impacts the signs and symptoms of CHAPLE disease from the patient perspective by combining within-trial interviews and clinical outcome assessments (COAs) (ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04209634).

pmc-11416639.title: Protocol for detecting lysosome quantity and membrane permeability in acute myeloid leukemia cell lines
pmc-11416639.creator: Kexiu Huang, Xinya Jiang, Juan Du, Hui Zeng
pmc-11416639.description: SummaryLysosomal function and activity are essential to support cellular adaptation to multiple stresses. For example, certain drugs can induce increased lysosomal membrane permeability to exert their anti-cancer effects. Here, we present a protocol to evaluate the lysosome alterations induced by drug treatment. We first describe the steps for inducing lysosomal alterations in cultured cells.

pmc-11441860.title: HCC spatial transcriptomic profiling reveals significant and potentially targetable cancer-endothelial interactions
pmc-11441860.creator: Chenyue Lu, Amaya Pankaj, Michael Raabe, Cole Nawrocki, Ann Liu, Nova Xu, Bidish K. Patel, Matthew J. Emmett, Avril K. Coley, Cristina R. Ferrone, Vikram Deshpande, Irun Bhan, Yujin Hoshida, David T. Ting, Martin J. Aryee, Joseph W. Franses
pmc-11441860.description: Background:HCC is a highly vascular tumor, and many effective drug regimens target the tumor blood vessels. Prior bulk HCC subtyping data used bulk transcriptomes, which contained a mixture of parenchymal and stromal contributions.Methods:We utilized computational deconvolution and cell-cell interaction analyses to cell type-specific (tumor-enriched and vessel-enriched) spatial transcriptomic data collected from 41 resected HCC tissue specimens.

pmc-11519387.title: Transforming Global Health: Dr. Gagandeep Kang's Legacy in Microbiology and Public Health
pmc-11519387.creator: Radha Kunjalwar, Akshunna Keerti
pmc-11519387.description: Dr. Gagandeep Kang is a towering personality in the field of microbiology and is known for her groundbreaking work globally. She made seminal discoveries in areas of enteric infections, vaccine development, and public health that have created a sea of change in scientific understanding and healthcare, probably beyond the borders of India.

pmc-11667286.title: Bile acids in the lower airways is associated with airway microbiota changes in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: an observational study
pmc-11667286.creator: Jose A Caparros-Martin, Montserrat Saladié, S Patricia Agudelo-Romero, Kristy S Nichol, F Jerry Reen, Yuben P Moodley, Siobhain Mulrennan, Stephen Stick, Peter A B Wark, Fergal O’Gara
pmc-11667286.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundChronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a complex disorder with a high degree of interindividual variability. Gastrointestinal dysfunction is common in patients with COPD and has been proposed to influence the clinical progression of the disease. Using the presence of bile acid(s) (BA) in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid as a marker of gastric aspiration, we evaluated the relationships between BAs, clinical outcomes and bacterial lung colonisation.MethodsWe used BAL specimens from a cohort of patients with COPD and healthy controls.

pmc-13283448.title: Evidence that disruption of Discoidin domain receptor 2 contributes to palate malformations through effects on the extracellular matrix
pmc-13283448.creator: Julia A Capecki, Helena Shkuro, Öznur Yilmaz, Lisa Schmitt, Khadija Channab, Tobias T Lindenberg, Teresa Kruse, Sarah Achterrath, Berta Crespo, Anna Siewert, Mostafa Bakhshi, Leandra Pantel, Kerstin U Ludwig, Matthias Geyer, Elisabeth Mangold, Benjamin Odermatt, Nina Ishorst
pmc-13283448.description: Orofacial clefting (OFC) is among the most common birth defects and can occur either as part of a syndrome or in isolation (nonsyndromic, ns). Cleft palate only (CPO) is an OFC subtype. Here, we searched for novel nsCPO risk genes carrying homozygous and compound-heterozygous variants, by analyzing exome data from six sibling pairs with nsCPO born to unaffected parents.
